summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only investigation) I traced the full chain: `client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `db/auth.ts` / cookie config. Contrary to the ticket's assumption, **the watchlist ownership scoping is actually correct**: - No localStorage/anonymous fallback anywhere in the watchlist client code. - Every server handler re-derives `userId` from the session token and filters by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` on every read/write. - `active
